title: 'You're not welcome here' - Chelsea's Fofana booed by own fans
summary: Image source, Getty ImagesImage caption, Wesley Fofana has made 10 appearances for Chelsea this season. Football reporterPublished8 minutes agoChelsea defender Wesley Fofana was subjected to boos and told "you'
content:
Image source, Getty ImagesImage caption, Wesley Fofana has made 10 appearances for Chelsea this season.

Football reporterPublished8 minutes agoChelsea defender Wesley Fofana was subjected to boos and told "you're not welcome here" by his own fans during Friday's Premier League game at Nottingham Forest.

The jeers aimed at the 25-year-old were heard every time he touched the ball and came after an unauthorised interview with French YouTuber Zach Nani was released.

In that controversial two-hour conversation, Fofana also appeared to joke about missing his penalty during last month's Carabao Cup shootout defeat by Liverpool.

Manager Xabi Alonso said the French centre-back had apologised and "it won't be repeated".

title: Füllkrug saves Bremen in injury-time as Gladbach squander two-goal lead
summary: Werder Bremen came from two-goal behind after the 85th-minute mark to salvage a home draw with Borussia Mönchengladbach. The Green and Whites did this for the second time this season as they also showed their f
content:
Werder Bremen came from two-goal behind after the 85th-minute mark to salvage a home draw with Borussia Mönchengladbach.

The Green and Whites did this for the second time this season as they also showed their fighting spirit at Borussia Dortmund earlier in the campaign.

Bremen came into the home game against Bundesliga's bottom-placed team with a huge Nordderby boost, but the first 20 minutes were all about the visitors.

Florian Neuhaus created the first big chance for Zento Uno before his powerful effort from range.

Just when Daniel Thioune’s men finally started to settle into the game, Gladbach took the lead from the penalty spot.

content:
Image source, Getty ImagesImage caption, Slegers initially joined Arsenal in 2023 as an assistant coach under Jonas Eidevall Arsenal have parted company with head coach Renee Slegers by mutual consent after a disappointing start to the season.

Slegers, 37, was initially appointed on an interim basis in October 2024 before being handed the role permanently three months later.

The Dutchwoman led Arsenal to a second Women's Champions League title in May 2025 and the inaugural Fifa Women's Champions Cup in February 2026.

But she leaves with the team sixth in the Women's Super League after 11 matches - 12 points behind leaders Chelsea.

Assistant coach Aaron D'Antino has also left the club, with assistant Melissa Clarke-Reed placed in interim charge as they begin the search for a permanent replacement.

content:

Of course, a result was in no way expected against the Italian giants, but once again, Sebastian Hoeneß was left frustrated watching on as his side passed up multiple opportunities in the final third - only to be undone by a pair of lapses around their own box.

In the league, VfB are unbeaten in three, however the 0-0 draw with Schalke last time out left a lot to be desired, with Dennis Seimen's goal peppered throughout last Saturday's topspiel.

Heading into the weekend, they sit eighth, two points behind Frankfurt, with a win putting them into the European spots as they aim to finally get their season on track after suffering five defeats in their opening 10 league matches.
